انفضحوا (form VII)
# اِنْفَضَحُوا (infaḍaḥū) /in.fa.dˤa.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
# اِنْفَضِحُوا (infaḍiḥū) /in.fa.dˤi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْفَضَحَ (infaḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
